difficulties.name: Rookie
difficulties.description: Opponents think more slowly and make more mistakes, more so as the season goes on, you have two more strikes, and a boss you lose to can be played again. Only their thinking changes: their ratings, the physics and your own team are the same on every setting, and it never changes with the score.

difficulties.name: Pro
difficulties.description: The standard game. Lose to a boss and the season is over. Later opponents are stronger teams, and think a little more slowly to make up for it. Difficulty only ever changes how well opponents think: never their ratings, the physics or your own team, and it never changes with the score.

difficulties.name: All-Star
difficulties.description: Opponents think faster and make fewer mistakes, and a loss to a boss ends the season. Only their thinking changes: their ratings, the physics and your own team are the same on every setting, and it never changes with the score.

trainingTraits.name: Big hits
trainingTraits.description: His body checks at speed always knock the puck loose.

trainingTraits.name: Breakaway speed
trainingTraits.description: 8% faster with the puck when nobody is between him and the net.
